rationale: The bounded product-semantics change spans three canonical owners and three source paths, so it requires a scoped formal delivery path. Verified Change is ineligible because it requires exactly one canonical owner and deterministic propagation; Compact Delivery is unsupported because completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are not supplied. With no architecture, runtime, policy, persistence, security, API, CLI, release, or cross-host impact evidenced, structured_slice is proportionate over structured_delivery.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Verified Change requires exactly one canonical owner, but three are supplied.
Derived paths exist and deterministic_propagation is false.
Compact Delivery requires visible approved UR, completed Brownfield analysis, and stored quick_task context; only the UR
No architecture, runtime, policy, persistence, security, external API, CLI contract, release, or cross-host impact is
Any broader impact than the supplied facts requires fail-closed escalation.
